open_points.subject: recovery after a refused approval
open_points.text: “an element whose approval was decided ... is not reached and so is ready”
open_points.question: Does “approval was decided” include a refused approval, even though A10 rule 3 says refusal writes `refused_by_owner` and ends the run `refused`?
options: Only an approved approval makes an otherwise unconcluded element ready; a refused approval leaves it concluded and the run derives `refused`.
Both approved and refused approvals make the element ready, contradicting A10 rule 3.
open_points.default_guess: Treat only an approved approval as making the element ready; a refused approval is concluded and makes the run `refused`.
open_points.unit: 30_modules.md:Facts several modules touch, and their one owner

open_points.subject: recovery after `not_applied` when a fresh approval already exists
open_points.text: “a wait that still holds stands, with its present reason; an element whose ... attempt the owner resolved `not_applied`, is not reached and so is ready”
open_points.question: If recovery finds both a resolved `not_applied` attempt and the fresh `requested` approval that A11 rule 3 may already have recorded, does the existing `owner_approval` wait stand, or does the resolved attempt make the element ready to be reached again?
options: The existing fresh requested approval wins: the element remains waiting and is not reached.
The resolved `not_applied` attempt wins: the element is ready and is reached again despite the requested approval.
open_points.default_guess: Keep the element waiting when a fresh requested approval already exists; make it ready only when recovery must perform the post-resolution reach that requests that approval.
